name: Backups
author: Misty
overview: Backups creates encrypted, verifiable Restic snapshots on a writable non-system volume or a connected Misty cloud remote. Credentials stay in the OS vault.
capabilities: Initialize encrypted local or cloud repositories
Create and verify manual snapshots with cancellation
Browse snapshots and restore into a new collision-safe local folder
permissions: Read access to chosen local source folders
Write access to the chosen repository and restore destination
Execute verified bundled Restic and rclone tools
getting_started: Add a writable non-system volume or connected cloud remote.
Initialize the encrypted repository after reviewing the destination.
Select local source folders and choose Back up now.
changelog: v0.3.0 - Initial production release with manual backup, verification, snapshot browsing, safe restore, and credential-vault storage.
